v.s: The Most Merciful
v.c: The Most Compassionate

q: (to Rasulullaah ﷺ and to mankind, guiding them with it).
v.s: Taught the Qur’ān,
v.c: taught the Quran,

v.s: Created man,
v.c: created humanity,

q: (in addition to this favour, He even)
v.s: [And] taught him eloquence.
v.c: ˹and˺ taught them speech.

q: (orbits which Allaah has set for them until their end of time). (Because of these fixed courses, man is able to accurately calculate time so that he can plan and organise his activities.)
v.s: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,
v.c: The sun and the moon ˹travel˺ with precision.

v.s: And the stars and trees prostrate.
v.c: The stars and the trees bow down ˹in submission˺.

q: (as a protective roof above the earth)
(in this world by which man can properly weigh in trade so that none is unjust to another)...
v.s: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
v.c: As for the sky, He raised it ˹high˺, and set the balance ˹of justice˺

q: that you do not transgress in the matter of the scale
(do not cheat people when weighing their goods).
v.s: That you not transgress within the balance.
v.c: so that you do not defraud the scales.

q: that you observe weight with justice and you do not weigh less in the scale
v.s: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
v.c: Weigh with justice, and do not give short measure.

q: has spread out the earth for people.
v.s: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.
v.c: He laid out the earth for all beings.

q: On it are fruit, palms with sheathed stalks
v.s: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
v.c: In it are fruit, palm trees with date stalks,

v.s: And grain having husks and scented plants.
v.c: and grain with husks, and aromatic plants.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you

(Since you cannot deny any of Allaah's favours to you, you ought to express gratitude to Him by obeying Him and fulfilling His commands. After reciting this verse, Muslims should say, “O our Rabb! We do not deny any of Your bounties. All praise and admiration is for You Alone.”)
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you ˹humans and jinn˺ both deny?

q: (Allaah mixed sand with water to make clay and then used the clay to fashion the mould of the first man, Aadam ﵊. When the clay had dried, it became hard and it made a melodious sound when struck by hand, just like a clay pot or vase.)
v.s: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.
v.c: He created humankind from ˹sounding˺ clay like pottery,

q: (After creating the first pair of man and Jinn, the rest of the creation were born from them.)
v.s: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
v.c: and created jinn from a ˹smokeless˺ flame of fire.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: The Rabb of the two Easts
(the two extreme points in the Eastern horizon where the sun rises throughout the year)
(the two extreme points in the Western horizon where the sun sets throughout the year).
v.s: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.
v.c: ˹He is˺ Lord of the two easts and the two wests.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

v.s: He released the two seas, meeting [side by side];
v.c: He merges the two bodies of ˹fresh and salt˺ water,

q: barrier so that the two do not transgress
v.s: Between them is a barrier so neither of them transgresses.
v.c: yet between them is a barrier they never cross.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: Small and large pearls emerge from the two of them
v.s: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.
v.c: Out of both ˹waters˺ come forth pearls and coral.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: (in size). (Despite their immense size, Allaah keeps the ships afloat so that man is able to derive great benefits from them.)
v.s: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.
v.c: To Him belong the ships with raised sails, sailing through the seas like mountains.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: (on the Day of Qiyaamah if not sooner).
v.s: Everyone upon it [i.e., the earth] will perish,
v.c: Every being on earth is bound to perish.

q: Only the countenance of your Rabb the Possessor of majesty and benevolence shall remain
v.s: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honour.
v.c: Only your Lord Himself, full of Majesty and Honour, will remain ˹forever˺.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: All in the heavens and the earth ask
from Him and He is engaged in some matter every day
v.s: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is in [i.e., bringing about] a matter.
v.c: All those in the heavens and the earth are dependent on Him. Day in and day out He has something to bring about.
v.h: All Stand In Need of Allah

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: We shall soon free Ourselves for you
(to reckon with you on the Day of Qiyaamah),
O the two of you groups
v.s: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.
v.c: We will soon attend to you ˹for judgment˺, O two multitudes ˹of jinn and humans˺!
v.h: Punishment of the People of the Left

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: of Jinn and man! If you are able to transcend
the limits of the heavens and the earth
(in an effort to escape My punishment),
You will be unable to transcend
(which you can get only from Allaah).
v.s: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from God].
v.c: O assembly of jinn and humans! If you can penetrate beyond the realms of the heavens and the earth, then do so. ˹But˺ you cannot do that without ˹Our˺ authority.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

m: you will (be able to) defend yourselves
q: A flame and smoke shall be unleashed on the two of you
and you will be helpless to ward it off.
v.s: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.
v.c: Flames of fire and ˹molten˺ copper will be sent against you, and you will not be able to defend one another.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: (The time shall certainly come on the Day of Qiyaamah)
When the sky shall split asunder and become red like hide
v.s: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -
v.c: ˹How horrible will it be˺ when the heavens will split apart, becoming rose-red like ˹burnt˺ oil!

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: On that day no man and no Jinn shall be asked
(The asking will not be the usual enquiry, to gain knowledge because Allaah has knowledge of everything. However, the asking will be merely to get them to admit their sins.)
v.s: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.
v.c: On that Day there will be no need for any human or jinn to be asked about their sins.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: will be recognised by their traits
(among these will be their gloomy faces and terrified blue eyes)
and will be seized by their forelocks
v.s: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
v.c: The wicked will be recognized by their appearance, then will be seized by ˹their˺ forelocks and feet.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: “This is the Jahannam which the criminals
v.s: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.
v.c: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Hell which the wicked denied.”

q: They shall pass between it and the boiling water.
(Their punishment will alternate between suffering in Jahannam and sometimes drinking from the boiling water which will tear their internal organs.)
v.s: They will go around between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].
v.c: They will alternate between its flames and scalding water.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: The one who fears standing in the presence of his Rabb
(of Jannah). (These two gardens of Jannah are reserved for those Mu'mineen who are extremely close to Allaah. The Jannah that other Mu'mineen will receive is mentioned from verse 62 onwards.)
v.s: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -
v.c: And whoever is in awe of standing before their Lord will have two Gardens.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

v.s: Having [spreading] branches.
v.c: ˹Both will be˺ with lush branches.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: there shall be two gushing springs
v.s: In both of them are two springs, flowing.
v.c: In each ˹Garden˺ will be two flowing springs.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: In both there shall be a pair of every fruit
v.s: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.
v.c: In each will be two types of every fruit.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: lined with thick silk. The fruit of both gardens shall be extremely close
(at hand, requiring no effort to pluck them).
v.s: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.
v.c: Those ˹believers˺ will recline on furnishings lined with rich brocade. And the fruit of both Gardens will hang within reach.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: In these gardens, there shall be maidens with lowered
gazes whom no man or Jinn has ever touched.
v.s: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinnī -
v.c: In both ˹Gardens˺ will be maidens of modest gaze, who no human or jinn has ever touched before.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: seem to appear like rubies and pearls
(because of their delicate and clear complexions).
v.s: As if they were rubies and coral.
v.c: Those ˹maidens˺ will be ˹as elegant˺ as rubies and coral.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: Can the reward for good be anything but good?
(The reward for the good done in this world will be the excellent bounties of the Aakhirah.)
v.s: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?
v.c: Is there any reward for goodness except goodness?

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

v.s: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -
v.c: And below these two ˹Gardens˺ will be two others.
v.h: Reward of the People of the Right

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

v.s: Dark green [in color].
v.c: Both will be dark green.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

v.s: In both of them are two springs, spouting.
v.c: In each will be two gushing springs.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: In both are fruits, date palms and pomegranates.
(Although sharing their names with those fruit found in this world, the fruit of Jannah will be vastly superior in every way.)
v.s: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.
v.c: In both will be fruit, palm trees, and pomegranates.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: In them are good and beautiful women
(who will be their wives). (Apart from their physical beauty, the women of Jannah will also possess excellent qualities and character.)
v.s: In them are good and beautiful women -
v.c: In all Gardens will be noble, pleasant mates.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: (Describing these women further, Allaah says that they will be)
v.s: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -
v.c: ˹They will be˺ maidens with gorgeous eyes, reserved in pavilions.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: Neither any man nor Jinn has ever touched them.
v.s: Untouched before them by man or jinnī -
v.c: No human or jinn has ever touched these ˹maidens˺ before.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: The people of Jannah shall recline on green cushions and most beautiful carpets.
v.s: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.
v.c: All ˹believers˺ will be reclining on green cushions and splendid carpets.

q: So which favours of your Rabb do the two of you deny?
v.s: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
v.c: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

q: Blessed is the name of your Rabb, the Possessor of majesty and benevolence
v.s: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honour.
v.c: Blessed is the Name of your Lord, full of Majesty and Honour.
